Cat-Cow.author: CPT Matthew Holfinger
Cat-Cow.reviewReason: Reviewed side-view footage shows both spinal flexion and extension on hands and knees, matching Cat-Cow. Clip excludes the front-view transition.

High Knees.author: CPT Matthew Holfinger
High Knees.reviewReason: Footage demonstrates a travelling drill; the existing catalogue guide describes in-place high knees. Do not substitute it.

Bodyweight Squat.author: MAJ Joshua Pena / Cpl Amber Jennings
Bodyweight Squat.reviewReason: Reviewed unweighted squats through standing, descent and ascent with feet planted and arms forward, matching the catalogue movement.

Side Plank.author: CPT Matthew Holfinger
Side Plank.reviewReason: Reviewed lower side-view panel shows straight-leg side plank raised from the floor on one forearm, matching the unweighted catalogue hold.

Plank.author: CPT Matthew Holfinger
Plank.reviewReason: Reviewed lower side-view panel shows floor-to-forearm plank setup and straight-body hold supported by toes and forearms; no weights or leg lifts.

Shoulder Cross-Body Stretch.author: CPT Matthew Holfinger
Shoulder Cross-Body Stretch.reviewReason: Actual footage is a seated spinal twist with one knee across the body, not a shoulder cross-body stretch. Title alone is insufficient.

Face Pull.author: Goulart
Face Pull.reviewReason: Reviewed standing cable rope face pulls show the rope drawn toward the face with elbows raised, then controlled extension; matches cable equipment.

Barbell Hip Thrust.author: Goulart
Barbell Hip Thrust.reviewReason: Reviewed barbell across padded hips, upper back supported on bench, feet planted and repeated hip extension; matches loaded barbell hip thrust.

Barbell Walking Lunge.author: Goulart
Barbell Walking Lunge.reviewReason: Reviewed forward travelling alternating lunges with barbell on upper back, controlled knee descent and forward steps; matches the walking barbell variant.

Alternating Dumbbell Curl.author: Goulart
Alternating Dumbbell Curl.reviewReason: Side-view footage does not establish alternating arm timing; do not use it to claim coverage for the alternating variant.

One-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.author: Goulart
One-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.reviewReason: Actual footage uses a neutral hammer grip rather than the supinated grip in the catalogue guide.
